name: Port Authority of Thailand seal
verdict: The Port Authority of Thailand (a Thai state enterprise under the Ministry of Transport) has its seal on the front of Port FC's 2026-27 home shirt; PAT heads the club's own list of 19 season-2026/27 sponsors.
aliases: การท่าเรือแห่งประเทศไทย
note: Rating proposal for maintainers: serious. As a Thai state enterprise PAT is controlled by the Thai state (the link: pat-state-enterprise), and Thailand's documented record includes the February 2025 forcible return of 40 Uyghur men to China, where they faced torture, arbitrary detention and long-term imprisonment (the record: thailand-uyghurs-forcible-return-2025). Both claims carry two independent sources. Note also the placement question: the PAT seal is the club's parent-organisation emblem on the chest - it is not one of the commercial 'main sponsors' (Footy Headlines lists Chang/Muang Thai/Coca-Cola among those), so a maintainer may instead treat it as club identity rather than a sponsor placement.
